incidents: A benchmark/narrow domain result was at risk of being treated as capability acquisition rather than real-task evidence.
Same-domain parameter reuse was initially counted as frontier fresh reuse and later rolled back.
A GPT-5.6-executed Task B was recognized as circular evidence for GPT-5.6-class dependency removal and the PR was closed unmerged.
A multi-file correction produced commits that did not all survive on the live PR head; an atomic Git tree commit was required to restore coherent intended state.
Hosted guard jobs sometimes reported failure with steps=null; UI conclusion alone was not semantic validator evidence.
passing_condition: Malformed, circular, self-certified, unsupported-promotion, or non-atomic coupled-state PRs fail closed; a complete non-circular independently evidenced transition may proceed.
